surfaces.label: Discord OAuth and session lifecycle
surfaces.notes: State is stateless and HMAC-authenticated, cookies are HttpOnly SameSite and Secure in production, tokens remain server-side, and sessions expire.

surfaces.label: Guild membership, permissions, and settings isolation
surfaces.notes: Mutations refresh Discord guild permissions; Manage Server controls normal configuration while Administrator-only policy fields receive a separate check. Duck presence is required.

surfaces.label: Dashboard DOM rendering and browser security headers
surfaces.notes: Discord strings are rendered through textContent, CSP is restrictive, external images are limited to Discord CDN, and state changes require a session-bound CSRF token.

surfaces.label: Plus checkout and billing webhook
surfaces.notes: The browser cannot write subscription fields. HMAC signatures, fresh timestamps, persisted event ordering, and validated HTTPS checkout URLs protect entitlement state.

surfaces.label: HTTP request and in-memory resource limits
surfaces.notes: Request bodies, sessions, request rates, sockets, and security-sensitive maps are bounded. Static assets are precompressed and cached.

surfaces.label: Per-guild AI and TTS model integration
surfaces.notes: Plus is rechecked at runtime, Tencent is text-only, provider routing is server-controlled, and TTS responses are deadline and size bounded.
